Aseem Baranwal
Aseem Baranwal on Scholar Aseem Baranwal on LinkedIn Aseem Baranwal on GitHub Aseem Baranwal on X Send an email to Aseem Baranwal

I work on Machine Learning at XTX Markets. My interests broadly span learning on graphs, statistical analysis of model architectures, and high dimensional probability.

I completed my Ph.D. at the Cheriton School of Computer Science at UWaterloo co-advised by Prof Kimon Fountoulakis and Prof Aukosh Jagannath, where I was a part of the WatCL Lab and the A&C group.

Prior to this, I received my M.Math. from UWaterloo, advised by Prof Jeffrey Shallit where I worked on algorithmic number theory and combinatorics on words. My undergrad was at IIT Jodhpur where I actively contested at the ACM-ICPC and several CTFs.

Fun fact: my Erdős number is 2 via Jeffrey Shallit.
